main_text.p: עָקֵב m. Calx, Calcaneus: hinc latè est, Ex-tremum, Extremitas, Extremæ pars: Extremò, Tandem: plur. עֲקָבִים Calcanei: Vestigia, & sic עִקְבִים & עקבות.
עָקֵב m. Emolumentum, Fructus, Præmium, Merces: & adverbialiter, Ad extremum, In finem usque, Finaliter: item, Pro, Propter, Quia, Propterea quòd, Eo quòd.
עָקַב Calcaneum tenuit vel apprehendit, Calcaneo supposito pessumdedit, Supplantavit, Defraudavit, Circumvenit. Pihel עִקֵּב Differre, Retardare, idem cum עִקֵּב.
עָקוּב m. Fraudulentum, Curvum, Pravum, Obliquum, Intortum.
עָקַר Ligavit, Colligavit, artus proprie, ut oves ad mactationem solent.
מַעֲקֶה עֲקָה m. Lorica, Loricatio, Peribolus, septum tectorum planorum, qualia in Palæstina erant.
עָקַל Pervertit, Perversum, Tortuosum reddidit: מְעֻקָּל Perversum.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew words are uncertain at this scan resolution and are copied approximately. The top running head is a Hebrew word that is hard to read and is given as printed as best as possible. The large Hebrew word at the bottom right is treated as a catchword.
